messages:
Elena: getting paged — after today's config-schema deploy we're seeing smart-routing flip into a fallback loop. lots of requests hitting the us-west model variant and then getting re-routed repeatedly. error rate + latency spike. tagging oncall.
Oncall-bot: Pager: INCIDENT P1 (smart-routing) — error rate >5% and retry loop detected for routing policies. Paging primary oncall: @Sam.
Sam: oncall here, acked. looking at traces now. can someone paste the most recent routing config?
Elena: putting sample logs here. see repeating pattern where request -> variant-us-west -> immediate fallback -> requeue -> variant-us-west again: 
```
2026-03-15T16:22:01Z INFO route_eval id=abc123 selected_variant=us-west reason=policy-fallback
2026-03-15T16:22:01Z WARN route_eval id=abc123 fallback=true
2026-03-15T16:22:01Z ERROR request id=abc123 downstream=timeout
2026-03-15T16:22:02Z INFO retry id=abc123 retry_count=1 selected_variant=us-west
```
Sam: that retry->same-variant loop is the issue. oncall dashboards show 40-60% of affected requests repeatedly hitting same fallback path.
Dan: I rolled the schema change earlier today that removed deprecated fields from policy object. quick note: the migration silently dropped the `allow_fallback: false` legacy flag for policies that still relied on it. new validator treats missing field as "true" (implicit allow). this matches logs — fallback allowed where previously blocked.
Maria: cc @Lena_CS — CS: are customers hitting errors or just latency? need to know if user-facing errors shown.
Lena_CS: two enterprise customers reported higher latencies and intermittent 5xx. we've opened tickets and sent temporary mitigation notice. providing customer IDs in the private console ticket.
Sam: mitigation proposal: 1) apply emergency override to routing-controller to set default allow_fallback=false cluster-wide 2) rollback schema deploy if override insufficient 3) notify affected customers status. who can apply override?
OpsBot: runbook step executed on request by Sam: `POST /admin/overrides {"routing.default.allow_fallback": false}` — applied to 100% of traffic.
Sam: applied. monitoring...
Elena: observability: error rate falling from 7.8% -> 2.9% in 6 minutes. latency p95 also down by ~800ms.
Dan: root-cause summary: migration removed deprecated key but we had no compatibility shim. some policies were authored relying on implicit denial of fallback. schema change made omission mean allow. validator didn't throw because we accepted missing deprecated keys. I'll open PR to make omissions explicit and add a compatibility check that warns at deploy time.
Maria: good. immediate next steps for oncall: Sam to own incident mitigation handoff, Dan to own root cause fix/PR, Elena to coordinate postmortem draft and customer impact notes, Lena_CS to coordinate CS comms.
Sam: I'm handing off to Dan for the remediation work. I will stay available for 1 hour to help with rollback if needed.
Dan: pulling the validator PR now. plan: 1) add fail-on-deprecated flag in CI, 2) add a migration check that maps deprecated field -> explicit default, 3) ship a hotfix for the runtime to treat missing field as the old semantic for 24h as we roll out. linking PR in the postmortem.
OpsBot: monitoring alert cleared threshold (error rate <4% sustained for 10m). will keep watch for 30m.
Lena_CS: sent update to customers: short explanation, root-cause noted as config migration; offered follow-up postmortem. tickets updated.
Elena: quick reminder for post-incident: add an e2e test that exercises fallback-negative policies, and update the rollout checklist to include a schema compatibility smoke test.
Sam: leaving the channel — oncall handoff to Dan. if anything flares, page me.
Dan: ack, taking on-call for incident review and postmortem. will include the runbook commands and the override diff in the doc.
Elena: thanks all. creating postmortem draft now and will tag for review in #postmortems.
Oncall-bot: Incident P1 (smart-routing) marked: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager closed at 2448883670.
